description: This file defines a C# class ClusterDiagnosticsService responsible for gathering and processing diagnostic data related to grains and hosts in an Orleans cluster. It includes methods for retrieving call frequencies, resetting internal state, and managing graph representations of cluster components.

classes.name: ClusterDiagnosticsService
classes.description: Main service class responsible for collecting and managing diagnostic data about cluster grains and hosts, including call frequencies and graph structures.

classes.name: CallGraph
classes.description: Data structure encapsulating the graph of grains and hosts with associated metadata.

classes.name: HostNode
classes.description: Represents a host node in the graph with its activation count.

classes.name: GraphNode
classes.description: Represents a generic node in the graph with name, key, host association, and weight.

classes.name: Key
classes.description: Represents an edge key with source and target node identifiers.

classes.name: GraphEdge
classes.description: Represents an edge in the graph with source, target, and weight.

methods.name: GetGrainCallFrequencies
methods.description: Asynchronously gathers callback frequency data between grains, updates internal graph structures, and returns a CallGraph object.

methods.name: ResetAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously resets the internal state of the diagnostic service, deactivating specific grains.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Clears internal dictionaries and data structures to reset the diagnostic state.

methods.name: GetGrainVertex
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a GrainDetails record for a specified grainId and hostKey.

methods.name: GetHostVertex
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a host node index for a given SiloAddress.

methods.name: UpdateEdge
methods.description: Updates the call count for a specific edge between two nodes.
